mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation / Certificate of Company Registration of the Taiwanese investing shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Taiwan Ministry of Economic Affairs, Department of Commercial Law
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Taiwan court notary notarization -> Straits Exchange Foundation (SEF) verification -> Association for Relations Across the Taiwan Straits (ARATS) confirmation for PRC use; this special cross-strait verification route is mutually exclusive with Hague Apostille and with consular legalization, and no further chain is permitted.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Taiwan Ministry of Economic Affairs, Department of Commercial Law (or the competent registry of the foreign parent company)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille route: issue ordinary certificate in the source country, then add apostille from that country's designated Competent Authority only if the source country is an Apostille Convention member. Consular Legalization route for non-members: notarize the document, authenticate at the source country Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and legalize at the PRC Embassy or Consulate; apostille and consular legalization are parallel alternatives and are never combined sequentially.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution / Power of Attorney authorizing WFOE formation and UBO nominee appointments
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of directors of the Taiwanese investing company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Execute before a Taiwan court notary and complete SEF/ARATS cross-strait verification for PRC use; alternatively, if the ultimate investor document originates in a Hague Apostille state, attach only the apostille; if it originates in a non-member state, use only notarization plus MFA authentication plus PRC consular legalization. Do not combine apostille and consular steps.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association of the investing company and draft Articles of Association of the PRC WFOE
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Taiwan investing company for investor articles; PRC notary or licensed formation counsel for the WFOE draft
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Taiwan-issued articles: Taiwan notarization plus SEF/ARATS cross-strait verification. PRC-issued WFOE articles: PRC notarization where execution authenticity is required; for use in another destination, either attach a Hague Apostille if that destination is an Apostille Convention member, or use PRC consular legalization if the destination is a non-member. Apostille and consular legalization are mutually exclusive.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter for the Taiwanese investor and the proposed WFOE
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Source bank in Taiwan, or an internationally recognized bank selected by the investor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille route if the issuing bank is located in an Apostille Convention jurisdiction: issue letter, authenticate by the local notary if required, and add apostille from the designated Competent Authority. Consular Legalization route for non-member jurisdictions: notarize the bank officer's signature, authenticate at the source country foreign affairs ministry, and legalize at the PRC Embassy or Consulate. Never use both routes in one chain.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: UBO Declaration and Government-Only Access Beneficial Owner Information Report
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Taiwan investing company and each natural-person ultimate beneficial owner, filed electronically through the PBOC/SAMR Beneficial Owner Information System
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: If signed in Mainland China, certify signatures by a PRC notary public; if signed in Taiwan, use Taiwan notarization plus SEF/ARATS cross-strait verification; the PBOC/SAMR government filing is direct and does not require apostille or consular legalization.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of every director, shareholder, ultimate beneficial owner, authorized signatory, GP principal, investment committee member, and person exercising control, including all persons holding ownership at or below the 25% legal threshold, must be conducted before acceptance, at formation, and continuously for at least seven years after closure against the UN Security Council Consolidated List,

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Taiwan Company Act, Articles 1, 2, 4, 6, 7, 8, 128 to 156, 172, 203 and 278; Statute for Investment by Foreign Nationals; Company Registration Regulations; Commercial Registration Act.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Department of Commerce, Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA), Taiwan, acting through the Company and Commercial Registration One-Stop Service; foreign investment matters reviewed by the Investment Commission, MOEA.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Company incorporation registration application together with the ratified Articles of Incorporation and the organizational meeting minutes, filed on the MOEA Company and Commercial Registration One-Stop Service portal.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: None under Taiwan Company Act for a general foreign-invested limited company; the Articles must fix a par value and authorized share capital, all issued shares must be subscribed, and the paid-in capital must be verified by an independent certified public accountant. No statutory blocked escrow account is required; however, the foreign capital injection must be approved by the Investment Commission, remitted to a bank account in Taiwan, and committed to the Company before the incorporation registration is completed. Withdrawals prior to registration may be restricted until the capital verification report is signed and deposited.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: PRO-FORMA RESOLUTION OF THE FIRST ORGANIZATIONAL MEETING OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF THE COMPANY. Pursuant to the Taiwan Company Act and the Articles of Incorporation of the Company, the first organizational meeting of the Board of Directors was duly convened and held at the registered office of the Company, located at the address recorded in the corporate minute book, on this date and at this time. The Chairperson confirmed that a quorum existed, that all directors received prior notice or delivered written waivers of notice, and that the proceedings were duly recorded in the corporate records. RESOLVED, that the authorized share capital and paid-in capital of the Company are confirmed at the amount stated in the Articles of Incorporation, divided into ordinary shares with such par value as prescribed by the Articles, and that the subscriptions made by the founding shareholders in accordance with the foreign investment approval issued by the Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs, are hereby ratified, accepted, and confirmed. RESOLVED, FURTHER, that the Board instructs the Chief Financial Officer to obtain a capital verification report by an independent certified public accountant, to maintain the share register, and to issue share certificates upon full payment of the capital subscriptions. RESOLVED, FURTHER, that the registered office of the Company is hereby fixed and adopted as the address stated in the notice of this meeting, and that the Chairperson, Managing Director, and Corporate Secretary are authorized to execute and deliver the lease, municipal registration forms, corporate seal applications, and statutory filings necessary to declare and publicize such registered office. RESOLVED, FURTHER, that the following statutory officers are appointed to serve until the next annual general meeting of shareholders: the Chairperson, the Managing Director, the Corporate Secretary, and the Chief Financial Officer. Each officer shall have the powers and duties assigned by the Articles of Incorporation and by applicable Taiwan law, shall execute all documents on behalf of the Company, and shall supervise the maintenance of statutory books and records. RESOLVED, FURTHER, that the Board authorizes the opening of a New Taiwan Dollar operating account and one or more foreign currency accounts with the bank selected by management, and authorizes the Managing Director and Chief Financial Officer, acting jointly under a two-signatory bank mandate, to give instructions on those accounts and to use wire transfer and SWIFT payment rails for capital calls, capital distributions, fees, operating expenses, and statutory payments. RESOLVED, FURTHER, that the financial year of the Company shall commence on 1 January and end on 31 December each year; that the shareholders shall appoint the external auditor at the annual general meeting; and that the Corporate Secretary is directed to file all required corporate resolutions, annual returns, and ownership declarations with the Department of Commerce and applicable public authorities. All acts performed in connection with these resolutions are hereby ratified, confirmed, and approved.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Foreign Investment Approval and Investment Commission Screening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA), Taiwan via the InvestTaiwan One-Stop Service Portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare and submit the foreign investment application before applying for company registration. The application must identify the foreign shareholder, the source and amount of funds, the intended business scope, and the proposed general partner activities of the Company. Attach certified copies of the investor's constitutional documents, audited financial statements or bank reference letters, a notarized power of attorney appointing a local representative, and a business plan demonstrating that the Company will operate as a venture capital general partner. The Investment Commission will screen the transaction for national security, fund provenance, and legal compliance. Upon approval, the applicant receives a Foreign Investment Approval Letter which must be quoted in the subsequent incorporation filing and must govern the timetable for inward remittance and paid-in capital subscription.
required_dossiers: Completed foreign investment application form
Certificate of incorporation and certificate of incumbency of the foreign investor, notarized and legalized for Taiwan use
Passport or corporate identity documents of all beneficial owners
Audited financial statements or bank reference letter showing source of funds
Notarized power of attorney appointing a Taiwan authorized representative
Business plan describing the venture capital fund management activities and anti-money laundering controls
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried, furnish additional evidence of fund provenance or revised business narrative through the same portal within 14 days. If approval is suspended, the applicant may apply for administrative reconsideration with the Ministry of Economic Affairs within 30 days and thereafter pursue administrative litigation under the Administrative Litigation Act.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-Reservation of Company Name and Business Scope
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MOEA Department of Commerce, Company and Commercial Registration One-Stop Portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log into the MOEA Company and Commercial Registration One-Stop Portal and submit a company name pre-reservation application together with the intended business scope. The proposed name must not be identical or confusingly similar to any existing registered name and must contain an appropriate corporate form suffix. Select the Taiwanese business classification codes corresponding to ISIC 6499 and state that the Company will act solely as a general partner, manager, and administrative agent of early-stage technology venture capital funds. The name reservation and scope description must be finalized before the Articles of Incorporation are executed because the corporate name inserted in the Articles must match the reserved name exactly. The reservation is valid for six months and may be renewed before expiry.
required_dossiers: Company name pre-reservation application
Proposed English and romanized company name
Business scope description mapped to ISIC 6499 and corresponding Taiwan classification code
Foreign Investment Approval Letter, if already received
Name search fee receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected because of similarity, file an alternative name application immediately. If the business scope is challenged as too broad, narrow the description to the management of the Company's own portfolio funds and respond to the examiner's query through the portal within five business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Notarization of Articles of Incorporation and Organizational Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Taiwan district notary public for domestic execution; Taiwan overseas representative office or recognized notarial authority for legalization of foreign-origin documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Articles of Incorporation in compliance with the Taiwan Company Act and the Foreign Investment Approval Letter. The Articles must set forth the company name, registered office address, authorized share capital, par value, classes of shares, number of directors, quorum requirements, financial year, and the permitted venture capital general partner business scope. The founding shareholders must execute the Articles, and all directors must sign written consent forms. Each foreign shareholder's incumbency certificate and authorized signatory documents must be notarized and legalized or apostilled according to Taiwan's legalization requirements. Certified English translations of any foreign-language documents must accompany the originals. After execution, convene the organizational board meeting to adopt the first board resolution and approve the banking mandate. The executed Articles and board minutes will later be annexed to the registration application.
required_dossiers: Final signed Articles of Incorporation
Notarized consent letters of all directors
Foreign incorporation documents and incumbency certificates of the foreign shareholder
Certified translations, if applicable
Organizational board meeting minutes and first board resolution
Registered office address consent or lease, if already available
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary refuses notarization because of incomplete foreign legalization, obtain the missing Taiwan representative office legalization and re-execute the corrected pages. If any director is disqualified, replace the director and re-execute the consent letters before proceeding to the registry filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Incorporation Filing and Issuance of Company Registration Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Commerce, MOEA, Company and Commercial Registration One-Stop Service
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the complete incorporation registration package through the MOEA One-Stop Service after the foreign investment approval and notarized Articles are finalized. The application must include the Foreign Investment Approval Letter, the signed Articles of Incorporation, the organizational board resolution, directors' consents, the registered office lease or landlord consent, and the capital verification report from the Taiwan certified public accountant. The Department of Commerce will examine the legality of the company name, the approved business scope, the directors' qualifications, the adequacy of the prescribed capital, and the conformity of all submitted minutes. Upon completion of the examination, the registry issues the Company Registration Certificate and the Business Registration Certificate. Legal personality is acquired only upon completion of this filing; business commencement before issuance of the certificate is prohibited.
required_dossiers: Application for Company Registration on the prescribed form
Foreign Investment Approval Letter issued by the Investment Commission
Notarized Articles of Incorporation
Minutes and resolution of the organizational board meeting
Consent forms and identity documents of each director
Registered office lease agreement or landlord consent
Capital verification report from a certified public accountant
Pro-forma first board resolution if not included in the minutes
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry issues a query, respond within 14 days through the portal and attach corrected documents. If the registration is suspended, amend the Articles or append the missing consents and pay the applicable amendment fee. A formal refusal may be appealed to the Ministry of Economic Affairs within 30 days under the Administrative Litigation Act.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration, Bank Account Activation, Financial Licensing Verification, and Office Compliance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Taxation Bureau of Taipei or local tax branch; chosen commercial bank; Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) if regulated fund-management activity is triggered; local fire protection bureau for office safety
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After receiving the Company Registration Certificate, register with the National Taxation Bureau for the tax identification number and any required labor and health insurance registrations. Open a New Taiwan Dollar operating account and a foreign currency capital account using the board resolution and the prescribed two-signatory mandate. Deposit the paid-in capital and retain the payment evidence for future foreign exchange and capital verification purposes. Analyze the actual management services to determine whether the Company's activities as a venture capital general partner fall under the regulatory remit of the FSC. If a license or permit is required, submit the appropriate FSC application before conducting those activities; if not, issue an internal compliance memorandum documenting the exemption. Finally, conduct an office fire safety inspection and obtain the standard commercial occupancy and fire protection certificate required for the physical office.
required_dossiers: Company Registration Certificate
Business Registration Certificate
Board resolution approving bank account opening and signatories
Officer identity documents and certificates of incumbency
Office lease and building occupancy permit
Tax registration application form
FSC application and supporting fund documents, if applicable
Fire safety inspection application and fire protection compliance documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the taxation office does not issue a tax ID promptly, correct any discrepancies between the Company Registration Certificate and the application form. If the FSC challenges any unlicensed activity, cease that activity immediately and submit a conformity plan with the FSC. If the fire inspection identifies deficiencies, remediate the cited items within the inspection notice and request a re-inspection before continuing office operations.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC), Taiwan; Department of Commerce, MOEA; Taipei City Commercial Office and local fire protection bureau for office premises compliance
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Company Business Registration Certificate, Financial Supervisory Commission Venture Capital Management Enterprise License or FSC exemption memorandum, and Anti-Money-Laundering compliance registration under the Money Laundering Control Act where the Company manages external investment funds

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Environment, Taiwan (Environmental Protection Administration)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - no Environmental Impact Assessment report is required for a non-industrial, non-manufacturing administrative office used for venture capital general partner and fund management activities under ISIC 6499. The activity involves no physical production, chemical processing, assembly, or warehousing.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable to the operational business model. General office sanitary wastewater shall be discharged to the municipal sewer system in accordance with local sewer connection standards. No VOC, particulate, or regulated hazardous air emissions will be generated. End-of-life fluorescent lamps, batteries, and electronic equipment, if generated, shall be removed by a licensed hazardous waste contractor under the Taiwan Waste Management Act.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable for physical chemical, manufacturing, assembly, or warehousing operations. However, the registered office is a commercial workplace and must maintain the building occupancy permit, obtain a fire safety inspection certificate under the Fire Services Act, install portable fire extinguishers and emergency exit lighting, and maintain an evacuation plan. General workplace safety obligations under the Occupational Safety and Health Act apply to office ergonomics, electrical safety, and emergency preparedness.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) of the People's Republic of China, official portal https://www.chinatax.gov.cn/
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign-invested WFOEs obtain Unified Social Credit Code and tax registration certificate from local STA bureau. SOP: submit incorporation documents, foreign investment approval, articles of association, and appoint tax representative; register online via National Tax Portal or service hall; issue within 30 days.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box elections; classification based on resident enterprise status under management and control test. BEPS hybrid mismatch rules may require recharacterization for certain structures.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: RMB 500,000 annual taxable turnover for general VAT registration (RMB 80,000 for small-scale taxpayers)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory real-time electronic invoicing through National Tax Portal with digital VAT stamps; API integration required for large taxpayers; invoices must include verifiable QR codes and specific fields.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT applies to goods exported outside China and qualifying offshore services where seller is non-resident and service performed outside China; requires proof of export and non-resident status.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Audits may be conducted; penalties up to 50% of VAT amount plus interest for fraudulent claims; retrospective clawback of zero-rated VAT; criminal prosecution for intentional fraud.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE, 国家外汇管理局), operating under the People's Bank of China (PBOC, 中国人民银行, the central bank); SAFE municipal sub-branches administer FDI registration and capital-account convertibility, executing day-to-day control through delegated Approved Foreign Exchange Banks (AFEBs) at the WFOE's registered address.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The renminbi (CNY) is fully convertible on the current account for trade, services, dividends, and interest without ex-ante SAFE approval; capital-account transactions remain governed by a registration/approval matrix under the Foreign Exchange Administration Regulations (State Council Decree 532, as amended). For a Taiwan-invested WFOE acting as a VC GP (ISIC 6499): (i) inbound equity capital is a capital-account FDI item requiring SAFE FDI registration, a dedicated foreign-exchange capital account (外汇资本金账户), and compliance with the payment-based settlement regime (支付结汇), including the negative list that prohibits settlement into entrusted loans, wealth-management products, securities investment outside permitted vehicles, and non-self-use real estate; (ii) profit and carried-interest remittances to the Taiwan parent are classified as current-account 'direct investment income' for BOP purposes but are procedurally conditioned on audited financial statements, a board-approved profit-distribution resolution, the FDI registration record, and the applicable tax withholding/clearance voucher; (iii) any cross-border conversion of proceeds from downstream portfolio exits is monitored as a discrete SAFE capital-flow event and may require registration amendments; and (iv) Taiwan investors are treated as foreign investors for FX purposes under the Taiwan Compatriots Investment Protection Law, enjoying no preferential FX quota and no autonomous convertibility, though they are eligible for pilot vehicles (e.g., Shanghai QFLP/R-QFLP) and RMB cross-border remittance channels for qualified private-fund structures. The practical remittance hurdle is not convertibility per se but documentary discipline: each CNY/FX leg must be matched to an underlying business record, a cross-border payment declaration, and the correct SAFE transaction-code family.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Not applicable to this mandate: the WFOE is a venture-capital GP with no physical export trade, and China abolished compulsory export-proceeds surrender in October 2012; exporters retain FX under a five-business-day receipt declaration obligation only. All inbound receipts for this entity are capital-account FDI items (investment capital), which carry no surrender or mandatory conversion ratio. Should the GP later repatriate proceeds from an offshore portfolio exit, those receipts would be classified as ODI repatriation and must follow the annual SAFE foreign-exchange stock-and-equity registration (存量权益登记) and the originating ODI registration, not trade-surrender rules.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 20% flat Profit-Seeking Enterprise Income Tax (Article 5, Taiwan Income Tax Act), effective for fiscal years beginning on or after 1 January 2018; a 5% retained-earnings surcharge applies to undistributed surplus beyond the statutory threshold (Article 66-9).
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No general tax holiday for venture capital general partners. Available relief: (i) dividends received from resident investee companies are exempt under the integrated imputation system; (ii) qualified venture capital investments in early-stage technology start-ups may attract an investment tax credit of up to 20% of the invested amount under Article 23-2 of the Statute for Industrial Innovation, subject to statutory per-entity caps; (iii) the Alternative Minimum Tax (Income Basic Tax Act) at 12% may partially tax otherwise-exempt securities transaction gains.
